dynamic_behavior_set_versions.title: Dynamic Behavior Set Versions
dynamic_behavior_set_versions.description: The retrieved dynamic behavior set versions.

has_more.title: Has More
has_more.description: Whether there are more dynamic behavior set versions to retrieve.

continuation_token.title: Continuation Token
continuation_token.description: A token to supply to the next request to retrieve the next page of dynamic behavior set versions. Only populated if `has_more` is `True`.

tool_call_specs.title: Tool Call Specs
tool_call_specs.description: Additional tool call specs that will be made available to LLMs.

overrides_existing_tool_call_specs.title: Overrides Existing Tool Call Specs
overrides_existing_tool_call_specs.description: During injection, whether the existing tool call specs are overriden with these new specs.

creator.description: The user who created this version of the dynamic behavior set.

overrides_instructions.title: Overrides Instructions
overrides_instructions.description: During injection, whether the original instruction of the state is overriden with this instruction.

version_constraint.title: Version Constraint
version_constraint.description: A [Python packaging version constraint](https://packaging.python.org/en/latest/specifications/version-specifiers/#id5) of the tool.

additional_instruction.title: Additional Instruction
additional_instruction.description: Additional instruction to be supplied to the LLM in addition to the tool's description.

audio_fillers.title: Audio Fillers
audio_fillers.description: A list of audio fillers to play in audio mode if the tool is taking a long time.

audio_filler_triggered_after.title: Audio Filler Triggered After
audio_filler_triggered_after.description: The number of seconds to wait before playing an audio filler.

result_persistence.description:
The type of result persistence for this tool call.

- If `ephemeral`, the result of the tool call is only provided to the current LLM interaction. Any future LLM interactions will not see this tool result.
- If `persisted-preferred`, the result of the tool call is reflected in all future LLM interactions if it's less than 5000 characters long. Otherwise, it's only visible in the current LLM interaction.
- If `persisted`, the result of the tool call is reflected in all future LLM interactions, unless it's more than 5000 characters long, in which case an error is thrown.

tool_name.title: Tool Name
tool_name.description:
An identifier of the tool that will be displayed in the description of this dynamic behavior set. This could be simply the name of the tool, or one augmented with
the context of the dynamic behavior.
